question: Where was the Santosh Trophy Final 2023, a national football championship, held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

__ 
 
• The **Santosh Trophy Final 2023**, a prestigious national football championship in India, was held in **Kerala**, a state with a rich footballing tradition. 
 
• Kerala hosted the event at the **EMS Corporation Stadium in Kozhikode**, which is known for its passionate football fanbase and world-class facilities. 
 
• The **tournament** is organized annually by the **All India Football Federation (AIFF)** and serves as a platform for showcasing local and emerging football talent across the country. 
 
• The state of Kerala has been historically associated with football, having produced numerous national-level players and hosting major football tournaments with enthusiastic crowds. 
 
• Kerala’s hosting of the final underlined its commitment to promoting football and fostering a football culture in the country. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 

__ 
 
• **Santosh Trophy:** 
 
 
• The **Santosh Trophy** is an annual football competition in India, established in **1941**. 
 
• It features teams representing various Indian states, union territories, and government institutions. 
 
• It is named after **Sir Manmatha Nath Roy Chowdhary of Santosh**, the President of the Indian Football Association in the early 20th century. 
 
 
 
• **Kerala and Football:** 
 
 
• Kerala is known as one of the football hubs in India, with cities like **Kozhikode, Kochi**, and **Malappuram** being centers of football enthusiasm. 
 
• Kerala Blasters, a team in the **Indian Super League (ISL)**, has further fueled interest in football in the state. 
 
 
 
• **EMS Corporation Stadium:** 
 
 
• The **EMS Corporation Stadium** in Kozhikode is a multi-purpose stadium primarily used for football matches. 
 
• It has hosted several high-profile games and is known for its electric atmosphere during matches. 
 
 
 
• **All India Football Federation (AIFF):** 
 
 
• The **AIFF** is the governing body for football in India, founded in **1937** and headquartered in New Delhi. 
 
• It is responsible for organizing national competitions such as the **Santosh Trophy**, I-League, and Indian Super League (ISL). 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 

 
 
• **Historical Significance:** The Santosh Trophy has been a platform for discovering football talent in India, with many players earning recognition at the national and international levels through this tournament. 
 
• **Kerala’s Achievements:** Kerala has won the Santosh Trophy multiple times, showcasing its strong footballing infrastructure and talent pool. 
 
• **Football Development:** Hosting such events helps in the promotion of football at the grassroots level, encouraging youth participation and the overall growth of the sport.
